items.title: George "Happy" Schilling Interview, 1957-09-08
items.q: And Sam, you have to say, come on boys, follow me.

ctx.x: I mean, did they make them up, do you think? Or had some of the older bands?

Oh, let me get you straight on a lot of this stuff. Like the Timberwood Blues. There's only one man who wrote the Wang Wang Blues. It was Gusty Miller with Paul Whiteman. He's in California now. He's got a couple of wrestlers out there. But he said the guy stole them numbers from Archie Le Parquet. The Clownet player. He used to make up more numbers than you could imagine.
